description: This Java interface extends JpaRepository to manage Book entities, defining custom queries with entity graphs for optimized fetching. It encapsulates database operations related to Book objects, including fetching all books, searching by title or author, and filtering by predefined shelves or user ownership.

classes.name: BookRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Book entity, providing methods for fetching books with various filters and relationships.

methods.name: findAllBooks
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of all books with related entities eagerly loaded.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Fetches all books with related entities eagerly loaded.

methods.name: findBookById
methods.description: Retrieves a single book by its ID with related entities eagerly loaded.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds books with titles containing the given string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Searches books by title or author name matching the input string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves books belonging to a specific predefined shelf.

methods.name: findAllBooksForUser
methods.description: Fetches books associated with a specific user, considering both owned and created shelves.
